title: Analysis of Moment Closures Using $\varphi$-Divergences for Rarefied Dynamics with Binary Collisions and Their Galerkin Discretizations
summary: This work introduces a robust deterministic framework for approximating solutions of the Boltzmann equation with binary collisions by discretizing their dependence on time, position, and velocity using Galerkin methods. By employing a family of parametric Galerkin closures based on $\varphi$-divergences in velocity space, we derive rigorous hierarchies of moment equations that govern fluid dynamic variables.
